title: Paired Rhyme · Together
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Paired Rhyme · Together with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose two players and a common word with several rhymes. The pair alternates saying different rhyming words until they have said four. The group agrees all four rhyme and none is repeated. Play eight turns in total, rotating the lead. The group wins together if at least five turns succeed.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Paired Rhyme, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group agrees all four rhyme and none is repeated.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The group agrees all four rhyme and none is repeated.
